scheme_name: City Gas Distribution (CGD) Network Startup Opportunities
overview: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) regulates the refining, processing, storage, transportation, distribution, marketing and sale of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas excluding production of crude oil and natural gas to protect consumer interests and promote competitive markets. It ensures uninterrupted and adequate supply of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas in all parts of the country. PNGRB was constituted under The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board Act, 2006, notified via Gazette Notification dated 31st March 2006. The Board oversees various divisions including Authorisation, Monitoring, Commercial, Technical, Consumer Affairs, Legal, Statistics, Strategic Planning, Sustainability, Coordination, and Administration to fulfill its mandate.
target_beneficiaries: entities engaged in petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas sectors
objectives: Protect the interests of consumers and entities engaged in specified activities relating to petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas
Regulate refining, processing, storage, transportation, distribution, marketing and sale of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas excluding production of crude oil and natural gas
Ensure uninterrupted and adequate supply of petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas in all parts of the country
eligibility: Entities engaged in specified activities relating to petroleum, petroleum products and natural gas (excluding production of crude oil and natural gas) are subject to PNGRB regulations as per The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board Act, 2006.
benefits: Regulatory oversight ensuring fair, efficient, and transparent activities in natural gas and petroleum products sectors; consumer protection through quality-of-service regulations; promotion of competitive markets; uninterrupted and adequate supply of energy across the country; safety and integrity oversight of downstream oil and gas sector; facilitation of ease of doing business through regulatory reforms.
financial_support: PNGRB oversees levy of fee and other charges on CGD, PPPL, NGPL entities and IGX; manages investments from Imbalance fund and APTEL Fund; finalizes annual accounts along with CAG and internal audit; analyzes financial closure of entities; prepares annual budget. No direct financial support to startups or entities is described in the evidence.
application_process: No application process for a startup scheme is described in the evidence. PNGRB functions as a regulatory board overseeing authorisations, monitoring, commercial, technical, consumer affairs, legal, statistics, strategic planning, sustainability, coordination, and administration divisions.
deadlines: No specific application deadlines are mentioned as this is a regulatory board, not a scheme with applications.
implementing_agency: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB)
contact_details: Email: e-statistics@pngrb.gov.in (for statistics queries); Secretary contact available via PDF documents; Board office: E-400, Fourth Floor, Tower E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi – 110029
caveats: PNGRB does not regulate production of crude oil and natural gas
Regulatory functions are divided across specialized divisions with specific mandates
Evidence does not describe any startup-specific financial support, grants, loans, or incubation programs under City Gas Distribution (CGD) Network Startup Opportunities
